selfSigned.title: Self-Signed Certificate
selfSigned.description: Creates a self-signed certificate on the server. Browsers display a warning, but the connection is encrypted. Suitable for test and development environments.

letsencrypt.title: Let's Encrypt (Free)
letsencrypt.description: An official Let's Encrypt certificate trusted by all browsers. It renews automatically every 90 days.
letsencrypt.bullet3: ⚠ The domain must point to this server via DNS

mailSSL.optionHint: Orders a separate certificate for mail.{{domain}}, smtp., imap. and pop., so mail clients stop warning about the name. Each of those names needs a DNS record pointing to this server.
mailSSL.secured: The mail server is secured as well ({{hosts}}).
mailSSL.securedPartly: The mail server is secured for {{hosts}}. Left out: {{skipped}}.
